guide.yagens_mobs.desert_skate.attribute: Hostile sand dweller. Adults have 20 health, 4 armor and 2 toughness. Young have 10 health.
guide.yagens_mobs.desert_skate.habitat: Groups inhabit sand and red sand in deserts and badlands.
guide.yagens_mobs.desert_skate.loot: Adults drop 1–3 raw skate meat and young drop 1–2. Looting affects adults.
guide.yagens_mobs.desert_skate.taming: Cannot be tamed. Dropped raw meat or fish draws it out of the sand.
guide.yagens_mobs.desert_skate.breeding: Feed adults raw meat or fish to let a ready pair breed.
guide.yagens_mobs.desert_skate.behavior: Follow its sand wake. It ambushes passing prey, then keeps its distance and fires tail spines. Its back resists most damage.
guide.yagens_mobs.condroc.attributes: Neutral bird with 16 health. Adults deal 8 damage on a dive.
guide.yagens_mobs.condroc.habitat: Most common in savannas. Also found in deserts, badlands and open ravines.
guide.yagens_mobs.condroc.loot: Adults drop 1–2 flight feathers, increased by Looting. Chicks have no flight feathers.
guide.yagens_mobs.condroc.taming: Cannot be tamed. Stock a Vulture Post with rotten flesh to attract adults.
guide.yagens_mobs.condroc.breeding: Two adults fed rotten flesh build a nest with 1–3 eggs.
guide.yagens_mobs.condroc.behavior: Condrocs dive at zombies. Post flocks carry one block per bird, including filled containers. A feather crafts a Mailbag for return deliveries.
guide.yagens_mobs.rock_hanger.attributes: Cave ambush predator with 40 health and 12 armor.
guide.yagens_mobs.rock_hanger.habitat: Dark ceilings with 16 blocks of clearance in ordinary, dripstone and lush caves.
guide.yagens_mobs.rock_hanger.loot: Drops 2–4 Rock Silk, increased by Looting. Shearing also yields silk.
guide.yagens_mobs.rock_hanger.taming: Cannot be tamed. Bait it with a spider eye beneath its perch.
guide.yagens_mobs.rock_hanger.behavior: It strikes players and spiders from above. Shear its feeding tuft for two silk, or cut its tether to drop it. It climbs back up walls. Wind silk into spools to rig climbing lines.
guide.yagens_mobs.bubble_salamander.attr: Aquatic animal with 16 health. Only adults can be worn.
guide.yagens_mobs.bubble_salamander.habi: Rivers and warm or lukewarm oceans.
guide.yagens_mobs.bubble_salamander.tami: Tame with three raw cod or salmon fed by the same player.
guide.yagens_mobs.bubble_salamander.bree: Feed raw fish to two tamed adults of opposite sexes in suitable water. Warm and lukewarm oceans are unsuitable.
guide.yagens_mobs.bubble_salamander.beha: Underwater, remove your helmet and use an empty hand on your adult. Its bubble supplies air and Night Vision, removes Mining Fatigue and underwater mining penalties. It detaches at the surface and travels in a water bucket.
guide.yagens_mobs.velocipod.attributes: Neutral arthropod. Adults have 80 health and 8 armor; young have 40 health and no armor.
guide.yagens_mobs.velocipod.habitat: Open ground in swamps and mangrove swamps.
guide.yagens_mobs.velocipod.loot: No species-specific death loot. Its backpack contents drop.
guide.yagens_mobs.velocipod.taming: Each sugar cane has a 20% taming chance. Adults can be ridden.
guide.yagens_mobs.velocipod.breeding: An adult that kills a large slime seeks a safe brooding spot. Feeding does not trigger breeding.
guide.yagens_mobs.velocipod.behavior: Stand on its back to fly, sprint and bank. Cane in its pack restores stamina. Grazers leave the root and try to replant cane. Young hunt small slimes to grow.
guide.yagens_mobs.lumen_butterfly.attrib: Passive insect with 8 health. The juvenile is a caterpillar.
guide.yagens_mobs.lumen_butterfly.habita: Flower forests, plains, sunflower plains and meadows.
guide.yagens_mobs.lumen_butterfly.loot: No special item drop. Stored positive XP returns to its owner or drops as orbs if unowned.
guide.yagens_mobs.lumen_butterfly.taming: Offer its matching plant: gold/dandelion, silver/azure bluet, red/poppy, black/wither rose, pink/pink tulip, green/cactus, blue/cornflower, brown/brown mushroom, light blue/blue orchid.
guide.yagens_mobs.lumen_butterfly.breedi: Adults court near their matching plant within eight blocks. Combine all nine lineages through breeding to hatch rainbow offspring.
guide.yagens_mobs.lumen_butterfly.behavi: Up to seven adult followers share XP from your kills. Interact to withdraw it. Colors can protect, heal, improve harvests or accelerate workstations. Rainbow shields the flock.
guide.yagens_mobs.salvage_ray.attributes: End flier. Adults have 24 health and 2 armor; young have 12 health.
guide.yagens_mobs.salvage_ray.habitat: Cliffside Salvage Ray nests on the outer End islands.
guide.yagens_mobs.salvage_ray.loot: No special loot. Carried cargo drops.
guide.yagens_mobs.salvage_ray.taming: Cannot be tamed. Drop chorus fruit to let a feeding ray recognize nearby nest boxes.
guide.yagens_mobs.salvage_ray.breeding: Deliveries to a recognized nest box containing chorus fruit can make an adult consume a fruit and become ready to breed.
guide.yagens_mobs.salvage_ray.behavior: Adults recover loose and falling items. Sneak-use a nest box empty-handed to register for rescues. Link boxes with a compass and select a ride with chorus fruit. Rays can relay long silk lines.
guide.yagens_mobs.snowcache_weasel.attri: Snow-dwelling mammal with 10 health. Adults can sort storage.
guide.yagens_mobs.snowcache_weasel.habit: Snowy plains, snowy taigas, ice spikes and groves.
guide.yagens_mobs.snowcache_weasel.tamin: Raw rabbit always tames it. Raw chicken has a one-in-three chance.
guide.yagens_mobs.snowcache_weasel.breed: Feed raw rabbit or raw chicken to two tamed adults.
guide.yagens_mobs.snowcache_weasel.behav: Adults sort chests around their worksite using the first item’s creative tab. With JEI, assign a Recipe Blueprint to gather ingredients, craft at a table and collect the order.
guide.yagens_mobs.kavat.attributes: Neutral feline with 40 health. Base attack is 8, or 10 for Vasca.
guide.yagens_mobs.kavat.habitat: Suitable ground in the Overworld, Nether and End. Coats vary by habitat.
guide.yagens_mobs.kavat.loot: No special death loot. Use a Genetic Extractor for genetic codes.
guide.yagens_mobs.kavat.taming: Wild Kavats cannot be food-tamed. Incubated Kavats bond to the player who starts incubation.
guide.yagens_mobs.kavat.breeding: Incubate ten genetic codes or two recorded imprints for five minutes. Trade imprints to select traits.
guide.yagens_mobs.kavat.behavior: Smeeta vanishes behind a decoy, Adarza reflects damage, and Vasca spends health to save its owner. Revive a lost companion with its coat material. Sighting a real Kavat records its breed, ears, tail and coat.
